summary.text: Tim Mathern is a Democratic state senator from District 11 in Fargo who took office in 1986 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A social worker by training, he is director of public policy at Prairie St. John's Hospital.

paragraphs.text: Tim Mathern earned a B.A. in sociology from North Dakota State University in 1971, an M.S.W. from the University of Nebraska in 1980, and an M.P.A. from Harvard University in 2000.
He worked as a child welfare caseworker, as supervisor of social services with Catholic Family Service, and as director of public policy for Prairie Saint John's.
Mathern assumed office in the North Dakota Senate in 1986.
Ballotpedia lists him as a candidate for governor in 2008, with Merle Boucher as his running mate, in a general election won by incumbent John Hoeven.
His 2025 assignments include the Appropriations Committee and its Human Resources Division, and he is vice chair of the interim Tribal and State Relations Committee.
